{{Top|leg}}
A '''remote processor''' was a decentralized [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] that was not equipped on the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] itself. In these cases, the droids were more like drones and did not have independent thought. The remote processor was equipped with an integrated [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] that beamed signals to a [[remote receiver]] installed on the droid itself.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

Depending on the model, remote processors could have operational ranges from five [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] for a cheap model to five thousand kilometers for high-end units. One major drawback to the system was that droids took a while to respond to the commands sent by the remote processor.<ref name="RPG-Core" />
